changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Keep EMPLOYEE menu visibility limited to workbench and visualization entries. Remove stale historical bindings that exceed the minimal default scope.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM portal_menu_visibility pmv USING portal_menu pm WHERE pmv.menu_id = pm.id AND UPPER(pmv.role_code) IN ('EMPLOYEE', 'ROLE_EMPLOYEE') AND pm.name NOT IN ( 'sys.nav.portal.workbenchOverview', 'sys.nav.portal.workbenchTodo', 'sys.nav.portal.workbenchFavorites', 'sys.nav.portal.visualReports', 'sys.nav.portal.visualSelfService' );
